description.value:
Tier Blooded

Activate passive, triggers automatically on a hit

Effect each hit against the same armored foe reduces its Hardness or resistance to physical damage by 2, stacking to a maximum of −6, for the rest of the encounter

Solid hits against armor compound, stripping more integrity each time.

cinderfall.incomplete: Each hit against the same armored foe reduces its Hardness/physical resistance by 2, stacking to -6 for the rest of the encounter. No selector modifies a different creature's own Hardness/resistance value from the attacker's own passive, and no companion effect record exists to carry a stacking counter on the target.
